place.title: Place {ref} (touch sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 3 pins into column f, one pin per row: SIG into {hole.sig}, VCC into {hole.vcc}, GND into {hole.gnd}. The touch pad faces up.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins. If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture.

why: {ref} notices a finger on its pad by the small change it makes to the pad's capacitance, and sets its SIG output HIGH while it is touched.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND pin to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref} from 3.3 V, so its output signal is never more than the Pico's 3.3 V.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}'s SIG output: 1 while the pad is touched, 0 otherwise. The module drives this line itself, so the pin needs no pull-up.
